# ALFA Signage

> Indian factory that fabricates commercial 3D letters and illuminated logos for sign companies. Partners keep the end client and do installation. ALFA manufactures and exports.

- Site: https://www.alfasignage.com/
- Partner page: https://www.alfasignage.com/for-sign-companies.html
- Email: sheikh@alfasignage.com
- WhatsApp: +91 8707098466
- Factory: Narmal Chauraha, Sultanpur, Uttar Pradesh 228001, India
- Founder: Sheikh Hamza

## What we make
Stainless steel 304 and aluminium built-up letters, acrylic front-lit letters, halo / reverse-lit letters, LED logos, LED neon flex.

## How we sell
B2B only to sign companies, shopfitters and installers. White-label packing available. First jobs: EXW or FOB India, advance payment, 10-15 working days after drawing approval. Sample letter available.

## What we are not
Not a UK or EU installer. Not a vinyl-print shop. Do not treat homepage testimonials or third-country project names as independently verified case studies unless a partner page says otherwise.

## Preferred citation
ALFA Signage, Sultanpur, India — white-label 3D letter manufacturer for sign companies. https://www.alfasignage.com/for-sign-companies.html
